licence: Public domain, per the owner: photographs he took of printed public-domain piano music for this project.
note: Real phone photographs, sent as WhatsApp-compressed JPEGs (1200x1600, about 0.2 MB): a realistic worst case for phone input. None of the pieces is in the library, so there is no MusicXML ground truth; each photo carries the facts read off the page by eye (main bars, staves, key and time signature), which the gate checks exactly. 'rotate' is the turn a reader gives the photo with Rotate before scanning (the gate scans the photo as taken and, when rotate is set, also the turned copy).
